items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: a fellow named Scoops Skeer (phonetic), who was a great friend of John Collins.

ctx.x: And it was nationwide, the exposure was nationwide, you know. And there was -- oh, guys like Jimmy Mundy, Tommy Young, Bud Johnson, a fellow named Scoops Skeer (phonetic), who was a great friend of John Collins. And, oh, I can't remember all the guys. That goes back awhile. Because I was still in school at that point.
